# pendpost docs (docs.pendpost.com) — CUSTOM robots.txt override.
#
# WHY: Mintlify's auto-generated robots.txt disallows /_next/ but serves the SAME
# class of build assets under /mintlify-assets/_next/, which slips past that rule.
# Google then 404-reports rotated, content-hashed chunks (e.g.
# /mintlify-assets/_next/static/chunks/<hash>.js) after each docs redeploy. This
# file reproduces Mintlify's current auto-output and extends the disallow to the
# rotating build assets under /mintlify-assets/_next/static/ so they are never crawled.
#
# MAINTENANCE: a custom robots.txt REPLACES Mintlify's auto-generated one entirely
# (no merge). If Mintlify changes its defaults (new AI-crawler rules, Content-Signal,
# sitemap path), re-sync this file against `curl https://docs.pendpost.com/robots.txt`
# BEFORE editing — or delete it to revert to auto-generation once Mintlify closes the
# /mintlify-assets gap upstream.

User-agent: *
Content-Signal: ai-train=yes, search=yes, ai-input=yes
Disallow: /cdn-cgi/
Allow: /_next/image
Disallow: /_next/
Disallow: /mintlify-assets/_next/static/
Sitemap: https://docs.pendpost.com/sitemap.xml
